method: Independently reviewed unchanged full raw streaming verifier and bound its 610-case/150-certificate receipt; independently recalculated every reduced probe from actual positive-minus-return pad voltages, all pass flags, both-grid margins, 15 impedance comparisons, 5 VCAP loops, and all 11 servo source-current illustrations. No solver, native geometry, meshing or repeated rawstream.

required_scope: 294 accessory/logic/USB cases only. All 11 servo cases remain illustrative.
limitations: Conditional enumerated DC model only; no global nonlinear-extrema, dynamic regulation, startup, voltage transient, package current split, signal-integrity or ESD result.
VCAP result is copper resistance only; excludes resistor, capacitor ESR/ESL, regulator dynamics and stability.
Raw servo bus bypasses U5; current/power/voltage passing cannot establish protection, harness limits or thermal/ampacity suitability.

The six heavier servo illustrations exceed the version-qualified 10A continuous Hobbywing rating; ideal-source voltage passing does not establish ESC suitability. Exact ESC variant, source/harness resistance, current limiting and operating profile remain user/system inputs.
KST servo board-pad screens use 6.0 to8.4V; output-harness servo-terminal voltage and startup/reversal/stall remain unqualified.
Geometry and this DC result do not establish fabrication, assembly, thermal, ampacity or flight qualification. Any copper change invalidates exact-source applicability until reviewed.
